question: Can one explicit real endpoint box support a constrained principal-action branch, a two-cell characteristic/composition interface, and a C1 midpoint pullback enclosure?
scope: SUPPORTING_METHOD; local real classical constrained branches
non_claim: No full BFV source, original relative cycle, quantum measure, fixed-T midpoint equality, global intersection or new physics/discovery.

inputs.selection: One declared local real branch and one independent vertex box; no box search, radius sweep, or automatic successor.
inputs.output: Uniform constrained action branch and two-cell characteristic/composition interface with a C1 pullback bound, or INCONCLUSIVE.

interface.composition_scope: Restriction of each full branch to its one-third split; any nearby matched pair whose concatenated shooting data remain in the full box has that same action. No global critical-point exhaustion.
interface.comparator_scope: Continuum-selected lapse pullback only; neither fixed-T nor stationary-midpoint source equivalence, no transfer of gauge identities to the midpoint action.
